title: Obriy Hub
description: A simple Velocity plugin that adds the /hub, /lobby, and /h commands. All commands are fully customizable via configuration.
body:
## About
This plugin was created specifically for my Minecraft server after I encountered multiple issues with existing alternatives.  
Some plugins were outdated, others were unstable, and many did not work correctly with my setup on Velocity.

The goal of this plugin is to provide a **simple, lightweight, and reliable solution** for hub and lobby commands without unnecessary features or complexity.

## Features
- Adds the commands **/hub**, **/lobby**, and **/h**
- Fully customizable commands via configuration file
- Designed specifically for **Velocity**
- Lightweight and easy to use
- Stable and predictable behavior

## Why this plugin?
I wanted a plugin that:
- Works properly on modern Velocity versions  
- Does not include unnecessary features  
- Is easy to configure  
- Just works without extra setup  

So I decided to create my own solution and make it available for others who might have the same problem.

## License
This project is **free to use**.
